resolution_notes: docs_url: Replace the original. Destatis migrated GENESIS-Online to genesis.destatis.de in May 2026, and its current official API page links specifically to https://genesis.destatis.de/datenbank/online#modal=web-service-api. Evidence: https://www.destatis.de/ExterneLinks/DE/genesis-online-webservice.html and https://www.destatis.de/EN/Service/OpenData/api-webservice.html. Neither verifier-supplied old www-genesis statistics-navigation URL is current API documentation.
